blocking.title: The mandatory review protocol is absent, making fan-out unusable
blocking.detail: `docs/reviews/AGENT-REVIEW-PROTOCOL.md` is absent from both HEAD and HEAD^ (zero committed paths). `tools/review/fanout.ts:222-224` terminates with exit 2 when it is absent. Consequently the declared review workflow cannot execute from this checkout; the issue predates this pin-only commit but blocks quality acceptance of the target state.

residualRisks: Dynamic quality gates were not run because the review mandate forbids creating or modifying files in the immutable worktree.
The governance SHA update is internally consistent across project.v1.yaml, package.json, bun.lock, and both workflows.
